defects.description: start and end are parsed as UTC midnight while a Date built from calendar components is local midnight, so the first or last inclusive day is reported inactive in any non-UTC zone.
defects.why_missed: The suite builds every probe date with the same constructor as the bounds and stays away from the first and last day, so the comparison is consistent by accident in every zone.
defects.severity_rationale: The inclusive last day is silently inactive for a date constructed in a non-UTC time zone.
defects.failure_condition: TZ=America/Caracas node: isActive({start:'2026-03-01',end:'2026-03-31'}, new Date(2026,2,31)) -> last day local: false

detection_criteria.mechanism: start and end are parsed as UTC midnight while a Date built from calendar components is local midnight, so the first or last inclusive day is reported inactive in any non-UTC zone.
detection_criteria.proof: Show one input or state where the output contradicts expected_behavior.

defects.description: setFullYear on 29 February overflows to 1 March instead of clamping to the last day of February.
defects.why_missed: The renewal test uses a day that exists in every year, so the overflow branch of Date arithmetic is never reached.
defects.severity_rationale: A February 29 renewal yields a wrong date on a leap-day edge input.

detection_criteria.mechanism: setFullYear on 29 February overflows to 1 March instead of clamping to the last day of February.
detection_criteria.proof: Show one input or state where the output contradicts expected_behavior.
